zh.title: 民航局舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇 邀國外專家分享經驗
zh.summary: 民航局11月23日舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇，邀國外專家分享經驗。
body: 交通部民用航空局11月23日舉辦「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」，邀請國外民航主管機關及專家分享實務經驗。
論壇聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範介紹。民航局希望藉由國外專家分享，促進臺灣無人機產業及制度與國際接軌。
民航局指出，先進空中交通要從技術研發走向實際營運，仍須建立適航認證、安全監理及空域整合機制。電動垂直起降航空器（eVTOL）等新興技術，未來有機會拓展都市與區域運輸、緊急救援及偏遠地區交通服務。

en.title: Taiwan CAA holds drone and advanced air mobility forum, invites experts
en.summary: Taiwan CAA held a drone and advanced air mobility forum on November 23, inviting overseas experts.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) held a 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility (AAM) on November 23, inviting overseas civil aviation authorities and experts to share practical experience.

The forum focused on international drone and AAM development and an introduction to international aviation safety rules. The CAA said it hoped the exchange with overseas experts would strengthen international links for Taiwan's drone industry and its institutions.

The agency said AAM still needs airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration mechanisms to move from research to operations. Emerging technologies such as electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft could eventually expand urban and regional transport, emergency response and transport services for remote areas, it said.
